title: Typography
slide_intent: Mark the transition to the type system and let the chapter heading itself provide a large-scale sample.
strategic_value: The repeated divider treatment can help a reader navigate between color and typography using the same visual cue.
demonstration: A white Typography heading and small 5.0 identifier share a left edge on a full green field.
practical_value: Use the divider to locate the specimen, fallback and editorial guidance that follows.

content_islands.name: Chapter marker
content_islands.spec: Place the 5.0 identifier with its small Typography label near the top left.

content_islands.name: Display title
content_islands.spec: Set the single word in large white type below the marker and leave most of the green field open.
